settings.title: Settings
settings.llmHint: The brain of the system: pipeline scoring, scripts, Studio runs and chat are all driven by it. Any OpenAI-compatible provider works.
settings.imageHint: Provides image output for Studio visual content, wired through ComfyUI workflows.
settings.ttsHint: Narration for finished videos; voice is picked per content automatically.
settings.aiKeysHint: Separate multiple keys with commas; local inference can leave empty
settings.aiKeysEmpty: Not configured — paste API key and save
settings.aiKeysCurrent: {{count}} key(s) configured — leave empty to keep
settings.aiModelsFetchHint: After creating, click “Fetch model list” to pull real models from the remote API
settings.aiProvidersHint: One provider can host many models; models are assigned to tasks by role (strong model for creation, cheap model for scoring)
settings.roleSwitched: Main model switched — applies on next run
settings.roleFallbackHint: Unconfigured roles follow the main model; if main is empty, the first enabled chat model is used
settings.roleMainHint: Which model powers orchestration and creation — your most-used one. Applies on the next run
settings.roleFastHint: AI asset organize / subtitle translation / scoring / titles: cheap fast model; leave empty to follow main
settings.featuresHint: Which model powers each feature at a glance. Adjust per-role models below under "Default models"; lightweight tasks like asset AI organize use the fast model
settings.redditCollectHint: OAuth credentials and login Cookie are two channels; either one keeps collection stable
settings.aiPromptsHint: System prompts are editable; changes apply on the next run. Reset restores factory defaults.
settings.aiTraceHint: Every model call: who called it, which model, latency and result — use this to find out which model ran and why it was slow
settings.aiTraceEmpty: No usage yet — run an orchestration or pipeline and every model call will be listed here
settings.aiNoModels: No models yet — fetch the model list or add manually
settings.assetsRootHint: Browsing root for the Assets page (breadcrumb start); empty = current project directory
settings.redditOAuthHint: Anonymous collection often gets 403 Blocked (IP/TLS fingerprint). Create a free API app (reddit.com/prefs/apps → script), fill in the credentials and collection switches to the official authed channel.
settings.biliPublishHint: With target Bilibili, uploads go through the biliup CLI (cookie auth). Drop your cookies.json (biliup-cli compatible) at data/core/cookies.json — running `biliup login` is NOT required (it forces a fresh QR login). Tokens auto-refresh on upload; run `biliup -u data/core/cookies.json renew` to verify.
settings.publishNoopWarn: Target is NOOP — publishing only records intent. Pick Bilibili in the dropdown and drop cookies.json into data/core/cookies.json (no login needed).
settings.sourcesHint: Check sources to enable; append custom subreddits below (comma-separated). Empty falls back to hot.
settings.subtitleStyleHint: ASS subtitle parameters — applies on next produce
settings.subtitleEffectHint: Changes apply on the next produce; existing videos stay unchanged.
settings.langHint: Translation direction: source → target (default English → Chinese). Empty source falls back to narration language.
settings.ttsTextSourceHint: Following subtitles requires translate mode; following narration uses the narration language.
settings.ttsPreviewText: This is a voice preview. Welcome.
settings.pricesHint: One per line: `model: input/output` (USD per million tokens), used for dashboard cost estimates. e.g. deepseek-chat: 0.27/1.10
settings.redditCookieHint: OAuth apps are hard for individuals — use browser login cookies instead: download/collect requests carry the Cookie header and CDN 403s stop. Paste raw cookies or auto-export from browser (yt-dlp).
settings.cookieExportFailed: Export failed — browser not logged into Reddit or yt-dlp missing
settings.cookieExportedNoSession: Exported but no login session cookie found (anonymous only) — log into Reddit in the browser first, then export
settings.cookieExportedBlocked: Exported but channel still blocked (HTTP {{code}}) — session cookie may be stale, re-login and export again
settings.autoCollectHint: Scheduler auto-collects all sources into the DB — small data, no manual care needed; download volume stays manual in the preprocess tab
settings.publishCookieHint: Drop cookies.json into data/core/ then re-check. biliup auto-refreshes expired tokens on upload — no re-login needed.
settings.publishNoopHint: Target is NOOP — publishing only records intent, nothing is uploaded. Switch to Bilibili in Settings and drop cookies.json into data/core/.
settings.cookiePlaceHint: Drop your cookies.json (biliup-cli compatible) into data/core/cookies.json, then re-check. Do NOT run `biliup login` — it forces a fresh QR login.
settings.cookieAutoRefresh: Cookie ready — biliup auto-refreshes expired tokens on upload. No manual action needed.
settings.cookieRenewOptional: Optional: only to manually verify / refresh the token
settings.depsHint: Checked once at startup and cached; re-check manually after installing/upgrading tools
settings.depsMissing: missing — see tooltip for install hint
settings.depsLibassHint: ffmpeg lacks libass — subtitle burn-in unavailable. Run brew reinstall ffmpeg, then re-check
settings.redditCookiePlaceholder: token_v2=…; session_tracker=… (copy from browser after logging into Reddit)
settings.autoPublishHint: When on, holding items auto-promote N per day and publish when due (queue only stores when off). Capacity counts auto publishes only; manual publishes are free.
settings.strategyBaseDaily: Base daily quota (when strategy takes over)
settings.strategyHint: When on, promotion/capacity follow account health: new accounts ramp up slowly; view drops halve the quota; suspected throttling (consecutive floor views) pauses publishing automatically. When off, static capacity above applies. See the Account Health card under Publish → Queue.
settings.strategyWarmupStep: Ramp step (+1 quota per N uploads)
settings.strategyDropRatio: Drop ratio (this week ÷ last week avg views)
settings.strategyCooldownViews: Throttle floor (median views per publish day)
settings.glossaryHint: Consistent terms are the foundation of subtitle quality: names/brands/proper nouns get fixed translations, injected automatically during translation. Toggle to pause a term.
settings.glossarySamplePlaceholder: Paste sample text or a transcript — AI extracts proper nouns worth standardizing…
settings.glossaryEmpty: No terms yet — add manually or extract from sample text with AI
settings.watchHint: When on, these subreddits are pulled at their own interval with the chosen sort; only posts matching the keywords are ingested — spending scoring budget where content is more likely to pop. Watched items still go through normal scoring & review.

cost.title: Cost Control
cost.missingPrices: These models have no price configured — their spend is not counted: {{models}} (set them under Settings → AI → Model prices)
cost.empty: No AI calls in this range
cost.scopeNote: Scope: LLM API calls only (scoring / script / title & packaging / translate / orchestration / chat). ASR and TTS run locally or on free channels and are not billed. Amounts are computed at query time with current prices — price edits restate history.

budget.critical: Month-to-date AI spend {used} / {budget} — past 80%, consider slowing production
budget.exceeded: Month-to-date AI spend {used} exceeds budget {budget} (≥95%) — the publish strategy engine keeps running; adjust budget or pace

suggestion.blocked: Source rejected or unreachable (403/404) — if it keeps failing the source is dead: reject & archive
suggestion.rate_limit: Rate-limited and cooling down — just retry later, nothing else needed
suggestion.timeout: Timed out — retry directly; cancel produce to reduce length pressure if it keeps happening
suggestion.llm: AI service error — check provider config & balance under Settings → AI, then retry
suggestion.tts: TTS failed — usually network; retry. If persistent check edge-tts connectivity
suggestion.ffmpeg: Media processing failed — missing libass? Run brew reinstall homebrew-ffmpeg/ffmpeg/ffmpeg
suggestion.download: Download failed — retry once; repeated failures mean the source is gone, consider rejecting
suggestion.publish: Upload failed — check Bilibili login state and whether cookies.json expired
suggestion.internal: Internal crash — check System Logs for the stack; a retry often recovers
suggestion.other: Unclassified error — click the row to read the full message
